settings.question: What exactly do I get?
settings.answer: A Shopify theme file (.zip) and a setup guide. The bundle includes all five theme files in one download.

settings.question: How do I install it?
settings.answer: In Shopify admin go to Online Store, Themes, Add theme, Upload zip file. The setup guide walks you through every step.

settings.question: Do I need any apps or coding?
settings.answer: No. The 3D hero, bundle offers, discount popup and slide-out cart are built into the theme, and you edit everything in the Shopify theme editor.

settings.question: Will the 3D slow my store down?
settings.answer: The 3D loads after the rest of your page, so your first impression stays fast.

settings.question: Can I try before I buy?
settings.answer: Yes. Every theme has a live demo. Open it on your phone, because that is where most of your shoppers are.

settings.question: How do the discounts work?
settings.answer: Shopify charges the discount, so you create the matching code once in Shopify admin under Discounts. The setup guide shows you how.

settings.question: What does the licence allow?
settings.answer: Use the themes on your own stores. Reselling or sharing the theme files is not allowed.
